name: cua
description: Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS fleets, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
one_liner: Gives an AI agent its own virtual desktop computer it can click around and use, so it can operate real apps like Chrome or Slack the way a human would, instead of only calling APIs.
buyer: A startup founder building an AI agent product that needs to click through websites or desktop apps that have no API, and wants a ready-made virtual desktop instead of building VM infrastructure themselves.
business_use_cases: An AI automation agency builds client workflows that operate legacy desktop software with no API, billing per automation built.
A QA/automation team generates training and evaluation data for their own computer-use agents using Cua Bench's task and trajectory tooling.
A startup offers 'teleport your signed-in apps into a cloud desktop' as a feature of their own AI-agent product, built on top of Cua Spaces.

money_ideas.idea: Resell managed 'Spaces' (ready virtual desktops for agents) as a subscription, as the project itself is moving toward with Pro/Teams plans.
Offer custom computer-use automation builds for clients on top of the open-source driver, billed per project.

steal_this: Pick one tedious desktop-only task (like filling a legacy internal tool with no API) that a client already complains about, and build a paid automation for it on Cua this weekend.
